full_prompt_en: A square oil painting depicts two women resting on worn stone steps beside a carved doorway and a cluster of brass vessels. The setting is close and richly surfaced, with pale sandy masonry, patterned tiles, and a dark recess occupying the upper background. At the center front, a woman in a vivid turquoise robe sits low on the step, her knees drawn close and one cheek resting on her hand. A turquoise veil with a narrow warm border wraps her head and trails down her right side. Gold-toned ornaments and trim catch the light around her neck and sleeves. Behind her to the left, a second woman in dusty rose clothing and a warm striped head wrap sits slightly higher, turning her face toward the first. A partially visible figure is dimly suggested in the shadow of the doorway behind them, but the two seated women carry the focus. On the left edge, pale patterned tiles and carved stone border the entrance. At the lower left, a tall narrow-necked metal vessel, low bowls, and small warm-colored contents sit near a cropped fabric-covered form. To the right of the turquoise robe, two rounded pots rest on the pavement, one glowing brown-gold and the other cool gray. Irregular pale stones cross the bottom of the frame, their joints and worn faces described with small broken strokes. Soft warm daylight falls from the left, illuminating skin, fabric folds, and metal, while the doorway remains almost black. Fine textured brushwork gives the turquoise cloth, rough stone, and polished vessel surfaces distinct tactile character. The overall composition is intimate and balanced, with a brilliant cool central garment held among warm mineral walls and subdued domestic objects.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画描绘两名女子在雕刻门洞旁磨损的石阶上休息，身边围着几件铜器。场景紧凑且表面丰富，浅沙色石墙、花纹砖片与深色门洞占据上部背景。前方中央，一名穿鲜明青绿色长袍的女子低坐在台阶上，双膝收拢，一侧脸颊靠在手上。带窄暖色边饰的青绿色头巾包住头部，并从右侧垂下。金色饰物与滚边在颈部和袖边接住光。她身后偏左，第二名女子穿灰玫瑰色衣服、戴暖色条纹头巾，坐得稍高，面庞朝向前一人。门洞阴影里还隐约可见一名被局部遮住的人物，但画面的焦点由两位坐着的女子承担。左缘的浅色花纹砖与雕刻石面围出入口。左下方，一只细颈高金属壶、几只浅碗和少量暖色内容物放在一团被画边截断的布料形体旁。青绿色衣袍右边，两只圆罐置于铺地上，一只呈发亮的棕金色，另一只是冷灰色。不规则浅色石块横过画面底部，接缝与磨损表面由细碎笔触交代。柔和暖日光从左侧落下，照亮肌肤、布褶和金属，而门洞保持近乎漆黑。细密有肌理的笔法让青绿布料、粗石与较光滑的器皿各有触感。整体构图亲密而均衡，一袭明亮冷色衣裙被暖色矿物墙面和低调的日常器物包围。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting has a finely worked but visible brush surface, with warm sandy neutrals supporting a few saturated jewel-toned areas. Edges are selectively precise around bright focal shapes and small reflective accents, then soften into textured shadow and aged support. Color is layered in broken touches rather than broad uniform fills, so adjacent warm ocher, rose, muted violet, turquoise, and gray areas breathe through one another. Soft side light brings forward pale planes and metallic glints, while a compact dark recess supplies strong depth and value contrast. Repeated irregular blocks create a firm lower rhythm against flowing, folded masses above. Small ornate marks enrich focal areas without making the entire frame equally busy. The spatial organization is intimate and shallow, with overlapping forms staged before a dark opening. Overall, the image feels richly observed, warm, and tactile, its cool saturated accent gaining force from the surrounding mineral palette.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅油画笔法细密，却仍能看到绘画表面，暖沙色中性色托起少量饱和的宝石色区域。明亮焦点形态和小块反光重音周围的边缘选择性精确，随后软化进有肌理的阴影与陈旧底材。颜色由断续笔触叠成，而非大片均匀填色，因此相邻的暖赭、玫瑰色、灰紫、青绿与灰色互相透气。柔和侧光让浅色平面和金属般的亮点前移，紧凑的深色凹处则提供有力纵深和明度反差。重复而不规则的块面在下部形成坚实节奏，与上方流动褶叠的团块对照。细小华丽的笔痕丰富焦点区域，却没有让整幅画同样繁忙。空间组织亲近而浅，重叠形体安置在深色开口之前。总体而言，图像观察细致、温暖且可触，冷调饱和重音因周围的矿物色域而更有力度。
theme_en: Two women seated on stone steps beside brass vessels
theme_zh: 两位女子坐在铜器旁的石阶上
name: Frederick Arthur Bridgman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
